ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base with high-intensity (white) localized clusters. Estimated 80:20 ratio of low-to-high intensity pixels across visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of high-contrast annular (ring-shaped) white blobs. Dense clusters located at the distal tips and along the anterior margins. Scattered isolated circles across the central black regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a measured obtuse angle of approximately 135 degrees and a medium-depth vertical recession.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serration map. Continuous jagged peaks (1-3 pixel height variations) across the entire trailing edge, with increased amplitude and irregular spacing near the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a symmetrical convex sweep from the notch toward the distal ends, terminating in rounded tips with high-frequency edge irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed constellations of white circular and annular rings (3-15 pixel diameter) consistent with barnacle attachment sites, covering approximately 25% of the total visible surface area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast diagonal linear pixel disruptions observed on the central lower region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation/notch on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe (viewer perspective), representing a significant departure from the natural geometric curve.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique density of annular scar patterns specifically concentrated on the outer third of both lobes, creating a distinct mottled visual signature.
